description: This file defines the 'Table' class for managing spreadsheet tables within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for setting table properties such as name, range, style, filtering, and handling internal references and validation.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Represents a data table within a worksheet, providing functionalities to define and manipulate table properties such as name, range, style, columns, filtering options, and internal reference updates.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the table.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the table's name, performing validation and duplicate checks.

methods.name: getShowHeaderRow
methods.description: Returns whether the header row is shown.

methods.name: setShowHeaderRow
methods.description: Sets whether to show the header row.

methods.name: getShowTotalsRow
methods.description: Returns whether the totals row is shown.

methods.name: setShowTotalsRow
methods.description: Sets whether to show the totals row.

methods.name: getAllowFilter
methods.description: Returns whether filtering is allowed.

methods.name: setAllowFilter
methods.description: Enables or disables filtering for the table.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Returns the cell range of the table.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Sets the cell range of the table, validating its correctness.

methods.name: setRangeToMaxRow
methods.description: Adjusts the table range to include the maximum row of the worksheet.

methods.name: getWorksheet
methods.description: Returns the worksheet associated with the table.

methods.name: setWorksheet
methods.description: Assigns a worksheet to the table, checking for duplicate table names.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns all columns defined within the table.

methods.name: isColumnInRange
methods.description: Checks if a specified column is within the table range and returns its offset.

methods.name: getColumnOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of a specific column within the table.

methods.name: getColumn
methods.description: Returns a specific column object by its identifier.

methods.name: getColumnByOffset
methods.description: Retrieves a column object based on its offset within the table.

methods.name: setColumn
methods.description: Assigns a specific column to the table.

methods.name: clearColumn
methods.description: Removes a specified column from the table.

methods.name: shiftColumn
methods.description: Shifts (renames) a column to a different position within the table.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the style object of the table.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Sets the style for the table.

methods.name: getAutoFilter
methods.description: Returns the AutoFilter object.

methods.name: setAutoFilter
methods.description: Assigns an AutoFilter object to the table.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of the Table object, ensuring proper copying of nested objects.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the table range when the object is used as a string.
